operation_details.item: The user sent the logo exploration set to the startup client.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Morning! Just sent the logo exploration set to the startup client. Feels good to have that off my plate.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice! That's a big milestone. Did you include the directions we discussed?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, I pulled together three mark directions, each with a couple of variations. Also glad I collected their questionnaire first — it made the options feel targeted.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Perfect. And you have the feedback call scheduled, right? That gives them time to review before you talk.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly, call's on Thursday. I'm curious which direction they lean toward. I have my favorite, but let's see.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: It's always interesting when clients surprise you. Are you feeling confident about the set?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Mostly. The visual language is pretty custom this time, not the usual generic startup look. Even if they want tweaks, the foundation is solid.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's the best way to approach it. Custom craft always stands out. Let me know what they say after the call.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Will do. After I send the set, I'm just tying up a few mockup details until then.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sounds like a solid plan. Enjoy the calm before the feedback storm!

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I sent the logo exploration set to the startup client; keep the questionnaire, mark exploration, and feedback call.
